cases.explain: «могучего врага» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.

cases.explain: «крепкое прибежище» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.

cases.explain: «большие победы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
